NEWS.BLURB: Telstra has just increased the price of its Starlink plan or 'Satellite Home Internet' as it sells it. Originally available for $125 per month, the telco has increased the price to $150 per month ongoing.
NEWS.TITLE: Telstra's Starlink plan just got more expensive (and faster)

NEWS.BLURB: Consumer communications body ACCAN has called for mandated mobile roaming during disasters, after the three mobile telcos created a limited technical capability.
NEWS.TITLE: ACCAN wants temporary disaster roaming mandate

NEWS.BLURB: Mobile provider Amaysim has paid a $138,600 infringement notice and entered an enforceable undertaking after the Australian Communications and Media Authority (ACMA) found the telco ported 13 mobile numbers without identity checks designed to stop them being hijacked.
NEWS.TITLE: Amaysim slugged with $138,600 penalty for unverified number ports

NEWS.BLURB: Dodo has moved nearly 100,000 internet customers to cheaper plans after reviewing their usage, a change it says is saving those households a combined AUD $1.2 million a month.
NEWS.TITLE: Dodo moves 100,000 customers to cheaper internet plans

NEWS.BLURB: More than 26,000 homes and businesses across the Mid Coast local government region are now eligible to upgrade to nbn Fibre to the Premises (FTTP) from a legacy copper-based nbn technology.
NEWS.TITLE: High-speed nbn boost coming to the Great Lakes community

NEWS.BLURB: Aussie Broadband has significantly expanded its Western Australian operations as it prepares for growing demand for high-speed fibre services and a major wave of NBN upgrades expected to begin from 2028.
NEWS.TITLE: Aussie Broadband Expands WA Operations Ahead of NBN Fibre Upgrades

NEWS.BLURB: A Senate committee has recommended the Government amend telecommunications legislation to mandate domestic roaming in a report prepared as part of an inquiry into Triple Zero outages.
NEWS.TITLE: Senate committee recommends mandatory domestic roaming

NEWS.BLURB: Around 64% of Aussie households are using outdated routers, which can significantly degrade NBN performance. According to a recent report from Opensignal, an independent organisation for analysing internet and mobile networks around the globe, this is having a big impact on the NBN speeds many people experience at home.
NEWS.TITLE: Most Aussies are using slower, outdated routers

NEWS.BLURB: Australian telcos should have to meet mandatory reliability and performance standards and “automatically” compensate customers impacted by outages, a major review has recommended.
NEWS.TITLE: Aussie mobile telcos face 'automatic' customer compensation for outages

NEWS.TITLE: Vocus Restores Perth-Singapore Capacity as ASC Cable Break Continues to Disrupt International Routes

NEWS.BLURB: Many small businesses probably aren’t subscribed to an internet plan that meets their needs, according to a recent report commissioned by NBN Co. In particular, 83% of small businesses rely on a consumer NBN plan, rather than opting for a business plan.
NEWS.TITLE: NBN Co finds 83% of small businesses use consumer NBN plans

NEWS.BLURB: A hardware failure at an Optus exchange in Victoria is being blamed for an Optus voice outage on Friday that triggered welfare checks by authorities in three states.
NEWS.TITLE: Optus outage attributed to hardware failure at exchange

NEWS.BLURB: Australian market research company Roy Morgan has once again announced Aussie Broadband as the winner in the telecommunications category of its annual Trusted Brand Awards for 2026. This is the sixth time Aussie Broadband has won this award.
NEWS.TITLE: Aussie Broadband is once again Australia's most trusted telco

NEWS.BLURB: Vocus is dealing with a break on its Australia Singapore Cable (ASC) system that runs between Perth and Singapore, weeks after the second major cable on the route experienced a shunt fault.
NEWS.TITLE: Vocus hit by Australia Singapore Cable break

NEWS.TITLE: ACMA fines Telstra for SIM swapping prevention misses

NEWS.BLURB: Telstra failed to prioritise fixing known vulnerabilities in its systems despite being warned about them months before they triggered a major nationwide outage.
NEWS.TITLE: Telstra outage caused by failure to prioritise well-known network vulnerabilities

NEWS.BLURB: When Telstra engineers embarked on a simple server chassis replacement exercise in 2020, they could barely have contemplated the complex chain of missteps and complacency that would, six years later, lead to a national outage.
NEWS.TITLE: Telstra sowed seeds for its July mobile outage in 2020. Six years on they sprouted.

NEWS.BLURB: Telstra failed to treat network timing as a critical network capability, with unclear ownership, insufficient expertise and weak process controls contributing to the nationwide mobile outage that disrupted services and affected some Triple Zero calls on 8 July, according to an independent investigation.

NEWS.BLURB: An unnamed 30-year-old telco employee is facing charges for allegedly accessing customer data and selling it to “criminal groups”.
NEWS.TITLE: Sydney-based telco employee accused of selling customer data

NEWS.BLURB: NBN Co and Amazon’s planned low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite-powered internet service is still a while away, with the latest update indicating a 2027 launch.
NEWS.TITLE: NBN and Amazon’s LEO satellite internet service pushed to 2027

NEWS.BLURB: The Internet Architecture Board (IAB) says it is concerned that age assurance approaches that rely on service provider checks will not only fail, but also leave youth less safe on the internet.
NEWS.TITLE: Internet Architecture Board says service-level age checks 'will fail'

NEWS.TITLE: Telstra urged to do better in connecting remote and regional Australia

NEWS.TITLE: TIO calls on government to address telco inequality in regional Australia

NEWS.TITLE: ACMA issues $88,200 in infringement notices under NBN rules

NEWS.TITLE: AFP assessing report in connection with Perth cable faults

NEWS.TITLE: Aussie Broadband actively exploring AI in customer service

NEWS.TITLE: Optus & Nokia hit 3.5Gbps in 6G trial in Australia

NEWS.TITLE: ACCC to consider mandatory domestic mobile roaming

NEWS.TITLE: NZ data centre builder contracts for new trans-Tasman link
